newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.200 to off 0.200 cent. Spot seen up on strong cash markets but deferreds easing on seasonal outlook.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Index up but corn seen higher and technically weak after failing Tuesday.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Strong cash markets and technically strong after reversal on weekly charts.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.500 to up 0.300 cent. Out-of-town bearish but Cold Storage estimates look bullish and cash market higher.
